name: Good Fruits
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are chosen by Christ to bear lasting fruit, demonstrating a life transformed by the Spirit and marked by love, joy, peace, and faith (John 15:16; Galatians 5:22). This fruitfulness is evidence of walking worthy of the Lord, pleasing Him through good works and growing in the knowledge of God (Colossians 1:10). Believers are also called to discern true from false teachers by examining their fruits, as outward appearances can be deceptive (Matthew 7:15). Ultimately, this fruit-bearing life flows from God’s grace and faith, encouraging one another toward love and good deeds (Ephesians 2:8; Hebrews 10:24).
